meanings: to go forward, to forge ahead, to advance, onward
ahead, in front, preceding, above, also pr. [qián mian]
to leave for; to proceed towards; to go to

surname Qiang, stubborn, unyielding, strong, powerful, better, slightly more than, vigorous, violent, best in their category, e.g. see 百强, to force, to compel, to strive, to make an effort, variant of 强
opportunely, coincidentally, as it happens, skillful, timely
parent, one's own (flesh and blood), relative, related, marriage, bride, close, intimate, in person, first-hand, in favor of, pro-, to kiss, (Internet slang) dear, parents-in-law of one's offspring
